result.material_update: Found a public autoresearch implementation that durably persists immutable evaluator-attempt intent before subprocess spawn, transactionally persists exact attempt outcomes/artifacts, and fail-closes ambiguous non-quiescent recovery. The remaining critical gap is logical evaluation exactly-once/statistical consumption: a proven-quiescent attempt lacking durable outcome can be rerun under a new attempt ID, so one adaptive logical query can physically execute more than once.
result.termination_cause: physical invocation boundary; research frontier remains nonempty

Prioritize provider-side idempotency/receipt ledgers and real controller SIGKILL tests. If absent, use dsh-autoresearch as the minimal implementation seam for a logical_evaluations layer and kill-resume equivalence experiment. Continue separately searching for candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, durable cross-candidate spending, bounded feedback and an adaptive-selection-unused outer test.
